verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a business communications SaaS like Quo, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any customer-selectable region or data-residency option. Canadian phone numbers and the us-west-2 S3 bucket hosting the API spec are not user-selectable data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
